C.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping and simplification)

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least/common denominator and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM for two denominators
Solution scales numerators/denominators to create like denominators before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and no conversion is performed
Only rewriting a whole number as n/n (e.g., 3 = 9/3) without an LCD step

skills.name: Subtract like fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions once they have the same denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution performs a subtraction of the form a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b
Includes cases where the numerator difference is 0 or negative
exclusion_criteria: Only subtracting whole-number parts of mixed numbers
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction without performing subtraction

skills.name: Mixed-number subtraction setup
skills.definition: Represent mixed/whole numbers in a subtractable form by separating whole and fractional parts or converting mixed numbers to improper fractions (including rewriting a whole number with a fractional part).
inclusion_criteria: Solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts separately (treating missing fraction as 0)
Solution rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with 0/d (e.g., 3 = 3 0/5)
Solution converts mixed numbers to improper fractions before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Borrowing/regrouping to fix a negative fractional part (tag S04 instead for that action)
Pure fraction–fraction subtraction with no mixed/whole-number representation changes

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: When needed, borrow/regroup between whole and fractional parts to avoid a negative fraction, and express the final answer in simplest form (reduce and/or convert to integer/mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Solution borrows 1 from the whole part and adds d/d to the fractional part (regrouping)
Solution reduces a fraction to lowest terms (e.g., 9/12 → 3/4) or simplifies 0/b → 0
Solution converts an improper fraction result to a mixed number as the final expression
exclusion_criteria: Only finding an LCD and converting fractions (S01)
Only performing numerator subtraction with like denominators (S02)
Only setting up mixed numbers without any borrowing or simplification action (S03)

B.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping and simplification)

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (LCD) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM of denominators
Solution converts fractions to equivalent forms with a common denominator before subtracting (e.g., a/b -> (a·k)/(b·k))
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and no conversion is performed
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction (e.g., 4/10 -> 2/5) without establishing a common denominator between two different denominators

skills.name: Subtract fraction parts
skills.definition: Subtract two fractions once they have the same denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution performs (a/b) − (c/b) = (a−c)/b (including cases where a−c = 0 or negative)
Solution subtracts the fractional components of mixed numbers after aligning denominators
exclusion_criteria: Only subtracting whole-number parts without any fraction subtraction
Only converting to common denominators without carrying out the subtraction

skills.name: Mixed/whole restructuring
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers or whole numbers into an equivalent form (e.g., separate whole and fraction parts, convert to improper fractions, or write a whole number as n 0/d) to enable subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Solution converts a mixed number to an improper fraction (or interprets a mixed number as whole + fraction)
Solution rewrites a whole number to include a fractional part with a chosen denominator (e.g., 3 -> 3 0/5)
Solution simplifies a fractional part inside a mixed number before subtracting (e.g., 4/10 -> 2/5)
exclusion_criteria: Borrowing/regrouping after a negative fractional difference is found (that is S04)
Pure fraction-to-common-denominator conversion between two denominators (that is S01)

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: When the fractional subtraction is negative, borrow/regroup from the whole part to make a positive fractional part, and express the final answer in simplest form (reduce and/or convert to integer/mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Solution borrows 1 from the whole part and adds an equivalent 1 = d/d to the fraction part
Solution reduces a fraction to lowest terms and/or converts an improper fraction or 0/d to an integer or mixed number as the final expression
exclusion_criteria: Subtracting fractions with like denominators without any regrouping or final-form simplification beyond stating the fraction
Only finding an LCD and converting fractions (S01) without regrouping/simplifying the final result

A.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers and simplifying results

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (LCD) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM for two denominators
Solution converts fractions to equivalent forms with a common denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and no conversion is performed
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction is done (no denominator matching)

skills.name: Subtract fraction parts
skills.definition: Perform the fraction subtraction once denominators are the same by subtracting numerators and keeping the common denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution subtracts numerators over a shared denominator (e.g., a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b)
Includes cases where the numerator difference is 0 or negative
exclusion_criteria: Only whole-number subtraction is performed
Only converting forms (e.g., to improper fractions) without executing the fraction subtraction

skills.name: Mixed/whole restructuring
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers or whole numbers into a form that supports subtraction (separating whole and fractional parts or converting to improper fractions).
inclusion_criteria: Solution rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with a 0 fraction (e.g., 3 = 3 0/5)
Solution converts a mixed number to an improper fraction (or expands a mixed number like 1 5/3 into 3/3 + 5/3)
Solution interprets a mixed number as a sum in parentheses (e.g., 4 − (1 + 4/3))
exclusion_criteria: Only subtracting already-prepared whole and fraction parts without any rewriting
Only simplifying a fraction (e.g., 4/10 → 2/5) without changing mixed/whole structure

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: When needed, borrow/regroup between whole and fractional parts to avoid a negative fractional part, and express the final answer in simplest form (reduced fraction, integer, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to fractional units (e.g., add 12/12) to complete subtraction
Solution reduces a fraction to lowest terms or simplifies 0/b to 0
Solution converts an improper fraction result to a mixed number (or otherwise formats the final simplified result)
exclusion_criteria: Fraction subtraction is completed without any regrouping and no simplification/formatting step is shown
Only finding an LCD or only subtracting numerators is shown without any simplification/borrowing/final-form step
